newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm, mainly in line with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, mainly in line with futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were firm, mainly in line with futures, traders said.
Gasoline was firmer and dealers said they expected U.S. arbitrage demand to kick in soon.
Naphtha was firmer too, and Europe's market was assessed tight, with only small parcels of each grade on offer.
